distractors: Deep in a single area at the expense of range, so the answers are strong inside a narrow band and thin everywhere outside it.
Applying only to a defined subset of cases, with the boundary written down so that anything falling outside it is plainly out of scope.
Agreed by everyone present with no dissent at all, and any objection formally minuted before the vote if there was one. The claim being made is unanimity, and a single hand going up disproves it.

Widening steadily over time to take in more ground than it started with, so that what was true of it last year understates it now. The word is about the direction of travel rather than the size at any one moment, which is why it is worth so little in a business case.

Stated so precisely that no reading other than the intended one is left open, which is exactly what makes it usable in a contract and useless in a conversation where the parties have not yet worked out what it is they actually want from each other.
